The '''Varvva system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Barsa sector/Legends|Barsa sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Varvvan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="AS" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the system to the [[Bars Barka system/Legends|Bars Barka]] and [[Iridonia system/Legends|Iridonia systems]], and it fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Varvva system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-6.<ref name="TEA" />
